other.content:
Verso of backing board: "10B" and "#113" in pencil, upper left corner.  "0.22" in pencil, top center.  "A Celebration by Georgia O'Keeffe  1924  Catalogue #113  Exhibition  7 Americans  1925" in pencil, upper right.  "OK" in circle in pencil, center.  Hayward Gallery:  exhibition label for "Georgia O'Keeffe American & Modern 1993" and catalogue number "46", with artist, title, and owner "Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation," upper center.  SAM address label typewritten with object info, center. 
Verso of frame:  "2108 OK" in pencil, center, right side.  "Tres Mowha Designs, Ltd.  851 W. San Mateo #5  Santa Fe  NM  87501  505-984-0118" stamped in black ink, center bottom. 
(Source: Seattle Art Museum, 2025)

cr_data.provenance: The artist; Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O’Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1989-1993; by gift to Seattle Art Museum, Seattle, Washington, 1994 (Source: Seattle Art Museum, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature" [notes backing inscription 2]. Reproduced and titled *Cloud Forms* in *Creative Art* (January 1928). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription 2, 1925 New York (Anderson) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: A Celebration

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Delicate, swirling clouds fill the frame. A sliver of dark blue sky zigzags down the center of the painting.
title: A Celebration
